gitCommit.body:
Public site: Blemhader.com as client work; v1.1 legal texts dated from their own publication

- Client work (D199): with its owner's confirmation (2026-10-18), the home and Services pages say that
  TSX-MR designed and built Blemhader.com for a client, and that the site and its content belong to its
  owner. Name and sentence only: no logo, screenshot, figure or link. EN/FR/AR.
- A legal text can carry its own effective date. Privacy, terms and legal notice v1.1 take effect on
  2026-10-18, the day they are published; the unchanged v1.0 texts keep the site's date
  (VITE_LEGAL_EFFECTIVE_DATE, 2026-10-17).

Tests: vitest 490, public Playwright 148, full-surface Playwright 130.
